$comment: Machines that can run the joed.dev stack. Each is a Linux environment with Docker (native, WSL2 or a Mac VM) on the Tailscale network, reached as `user@tailscale` over Tailscale SSH (or `user@address`, e.g. a LAN IP, while a host isn't on the tailnet). `skip`: compose projects this host must not run (hardware it doesn't have: Bluetooth, PulseAudio, the LAN DNS IP). `skipRepos`: repos whose deploy jobs stay on the other host when this one is promoted (they drive that hardware). `publicChecks`: URLs that must return 200 after a promote. `gateHost`: an app behind the joed.dev sign-in that every host serves; promote checks it redirects to the sign-in. Which host is ACTIVE isn't stored here: it's whichever runs the cloudflared container (see ci/scripts/host/status.mjs). Add a host with the `hosts` skill or docs/hosts.md.

placement.$comment: hostname → the host that serves it. Unlisted sites are served by the active host (the tunnel). Apply with ci/scripts/host/placement.mjs --apply. The radio is on glados because the speaker is wired to its headphone jack.

pinned.$comment: Compose projects that must run on ONE host at a time (two Home Assistants would both drive the lights; two radios, two speakers): the host their `site` is placed on. Every other host keeps them created but stopped, and its watchdog starts them when that host dies (and stops them when it's back). `refresh`: folders under /opt/services those hosts copy from the owner every 6 hours (skipping databases and logs), so a takeover has recent config. placement.mjs --apply starts and stops them to match.

watchdog.$comment: ci/scripts/host/watchdog.sh, on every host: a standby takes over when these sites get Cloudflare's no-tunnel errors and the active host is gone; alerts go to alertTo through site-mail.

hosts.name: glados
hosts.notes: 2014 MacBook Pro, 4 threads, 7 GiB, Wi-Fi. The speaker is wired to its headphone jack; it runs the LAN DNS (coredns on 10.0.0.172).

hosts.name: bouldergeist
hosts.notes: Windows 11 PC on the home LAN. The stack runs in a WSL2 Ubuntu distro with systemd and Docker Engine (not Docker Desktop); see host/windows/setup.ps1. Plays audio through WSLg (the PC's own output; bootstrap.sh binds its socket where the speaker container looks). coredns binds glados' LAN address, so it stays there.
